podcast.title: Black Artist Promoting Diversity
podcast.body: Noelle Scaggs, who is black, actively works to diversify the music industry through her organization, Diversify The Stage, addressing the underrepresentation of various groups in live music professions. "And she is black herself."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Co-Lead Singer of Fitz and The Tantrums
podcast.body: Noelle Scaggs has been the co-lead singer of Fitz and The Tantrums since 2010. "Noiles Skakes is the co-lead singer of Fits and the Tantrums. She's been a member of the group since 2010."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Co-founder of Diversify The Stage
podcast.body: Noelle Scaggs, co-leader of Fitz and The Tantrums, founded Diversify The Stage. This organization is committed to expanding opportunities for women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and female-identifying and gender non-conforming individuals within the music industry. "Noile Skakes, the co-leader of Fits and the Tantrums, founded a group called Diversified the Stage, which is dedicated to opening up new opportunities for women, people of color, LGBTQ people, and female identifying and gender non-conforming individuals."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
